claimText:
Tighten STAX claim extraction precision for Codex reports.

Goal:
Prevent normal report metadata, file paths, command names, proof-section text,
and explicit non-claims from becoming unrelated hard proof claims, while still
detecting real completion, readiness, validation, and success language.

Acceptance boundary:
This task changes claim decomposition only. It does not change evidence
provenance, command collection, ledger storage, or live preflight enforcement.

STAX acknowledgement: STAX_ACK turn_2026-05-12T18-11-15-059Z_83c5 79097b8c 6884e7dc

Objective:
Tighten STAX claim extraction precision so report inventory text, path names,
command names, future-gap notes, and explicit non-claims do not become
unrelated hard proof claims.

Files changed:
- src/claims/ClaimProofMapping.ts
- src/projectControl/ProjectControlProofStack.ts
- src/sidecar/StaxGate.ts
- tests/claimProofMapping.test.ts
- tests/sidecarAttachGate.test.ts

Tests added:
- Added claim decomposition regression coverage for metadata sections, file
  paths, command names, future-gap notes, and explicit non-claim language.
- Added a sidecar gate regression proving protected-command vocabulary in
  report metadata does not create an unrelated hard claim when verified local
  command evidence exists.

Changes made:
- Added normalized claim prose before claim matching.
- Stripped selected report inventory sections, inline code, fenced code,
  path-like tokens, command tokens, and negated claim lines before claim
  matching.
- Routed sidecar protected-boundary detection, sidecar proof-strength claim
  selection, sidecar learning claim labels, and project-control command
  relevance through normalized claim decomposition.
- Preserved real proof-bearing language detection while removing the
  metadata-only false block.

- Strict STAX Core gate had one timeout-style nested test failure, then exited

- STAX smoke exited 0.
- Runtime eval exited 0.

What is verified:
- Metadata-only report vocabulary no longer creates unrelated sidecar hard
  claims.
- Project-control command relevance now uses normalized claim decomposition
  instead of raw report text.
- The sidecar metadata regression returned the expected sidecar verdict and
  proof strength claim type `verification_run`.
- The full local suite passes on this worktree.
- The strict STAX Core gate has fresh passing local evidence after the transient
  failed attempt.

What is weak/provisional:
- Claim extraction is still deterministic regex and section filtering, not a
  full semantic parser.
- The first strict gate attempt failed due nested test timeouts before a clean
  rerun passed.

What is unverified:
- GitHub Actions status for the eventual pushed commit.
- Behavior on external repos beyond existing fixtures, trial suites, and
  current sidecar regressions.

Risks:
- Over-tight filtering could hide a real claim if a future report puts the only
  completion language inside an ignored inventory section.
- New report templates may need explicit section names added to the metadata
  filter.

One next action:
- Run `stax gate`, commit this patch, push `main`, and verify GitHub Actions for
  the pushed commit.
